title: Liquid Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry for Bulk Metabolomics
author: Dusan Velickovic
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.be2ajgae
materials: Waters CSH column (3.0 mm x 150 mm)
1.7 mL or 2 mL Sorenson MµlTI™ SafeSeal™ Microcentrifuge tube
Mass spectrometry is performed using a Thermo Velos-ETD Orbitrap mass spectrometer.

steps.title: Sample Lysis and Quantification
steps.instruction: Lyse the remaining biopsy sample (material not sectioned) and quantify the tissue weight.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL - 300 µL of MilliQ water to the biopsy tube containing the remaining biopsy sample.
Lyse the sample using a tissue lyser.
Quantify the amount of remaining tissue by weight.

steps.title: Sample Transfer
steps.instruction: Transfer the sample into a polymer-safe microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Place the sample into a 1.7 mL or 2 mL Sorenson MµlTI™ SafeSeal™ Microcentrifuge Tube.

steps.title: Lipid Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract lipids using a cold chloroform:methanol mixture.

substeps.instruction: Add cold (-20 °C) chloroform:methanol mix (prepared 2:1 v/v) to the sample in a 4:1 ratio over sample volume (e.g., 400 µl of mixture to 80 µl of sample).
Centrifuge the sample at 12000 x g at 4 °C for 5-10 minutes.

steps.title: Phase Separation and Recovery
steps.instruction: Separate the organic lipid phase from the aqueous layer and protein interphase.

substeps.instruction: Carefully remove and discard the upper aqueous metabolite layer until the interphase contracts, without disturbing the protein disk.
Carefully puncture the protein interphase with a pipette tip.
Remove the organic lipid phase from the bottom of the tube into a conical bottom Waters autosampler vial, ensuring any protein or upper methanol phase in the tip is pushed out.

steps.title: Sample Drying and Reconstitution
steps.instruction: Dry the organic layer and reconstitute for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Place the organic layer (containing lipids) into a speed vac to dry.
Reconstitute the dried sample in 100 µL of 95:5 MeOH:Chl in a vial.

steps.title: Sample Storage
steps.instruction: Store samples if analysis is not immediate.

substeps.instruction: Store in 500 µL of 2:1 Chl:MeOH in a cap (no septa) vial at -70 °C.

steps.title: LC-MS Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry to separate and identify lipid species.

substeps.instruction: Place the vial in the autosampler of a Waters H class LC.
Inject 10 µL of sample onto a reversed phase Waters CSH column (3.0 mm x 150 mm x 1.7 μm particle size).

Run a 34 min gradient at a flow rate of 250 μl/min using Mobile Phase A (ACN/H2O (40:60) containing 10 mM ammonium acetate) and Mobile Phase B (ACN/IPA (10:90) containing 10 mM ammonium acetate). Ensure the gradient is made fresh for each run.
Analyze samples in both positive and negative ionization modes using HCD (higher-energy collision dissociation) and CID (collision-induced dissociation).

steps.title: Data Processing
steps.instruction: Analyze and convert the resulting LC-MS/MS raw data.

substeps.instruction: Analyze raw data files using LIQUID to determine confident lipid identifications.
Convert LC-MS data to mzML format and upload to LC-METASPACE.
